title: A Toucan's Giant Beak Works Like an Elephant's Ears

scenes.text: A toucan's beak works like an elephant's ears.
The toco toucan has the biggest bill, for its body, of any bird.
It's light and packed with blood vessels.
When it's cold, the vessels tighten and the beak stays cool, saving the bird's heat.
When it's hot, blood floods in and heat pours off into the air.
Thermal cameras showed it. The bill is one of the biggest heat windows in the animal kingdom.

description:
A toucan's beak works like an elephant's ears.
Thermal imaging showed the toco toucan's huge bill changes its blood flow to dump extra heat when the bird is hot and hold heat in when it is cold, making it one of the largest thermal windows in the animal kingdom.
What other animal would you want to scan with a heat camera? Comment below.
first_comment: Elephant ears and toucan beaks do the same job. Which animal's trick surprised you most?
